messages:
sophia.li: Following up on AUTHZ postmortem - want to lock owners & set short deadlines for remediation items and also capture recurring failure patterns so they don't slip between teams.

noah.kim: +1. Can we also add a measurable SLO for audit-event completeness? Last incident showed ~12% missing delegated-token events.

owen.martin: I can own the token validation hardening work. Plan: centralize token canonicalization and add extra expiry sanity checks plus fuzz test harness. ETA 2026-05-05 for staging PR.

sec-analyst: For audit logging gaps I will provide a CSV of missing-event signatures from the incident dump and a suggested detection rule. Will attach in repo issue.

ops-bot: Reminder: task created -> TASK-4873 (owner: owen.martin, due: 2026-05-05).

sophia.li: Great. Proposed owners + deliverables: (A) Token validation & fuzz harness = @owen.martin (TASK-4873) - deploy to staging + canary by 2026-05-05; (B) Audit-event backfill + CI gate = @noah.kim (TASK-4874) - run replay job & add test by 2026-05-10; (C) Secrets rotation telemetry + alerting = @sophia.li (TASK-4875) - metrics + runbook by 2026-05-14.

noah.kim: Confirmed on (B). I'll schedule a 2-hour window to run the replay over prod-downloads subset. Also adding a unit test that asserts all codepaths emit `auth.audit_event` with required fields.

owen.martin: One implementation note: token canonicalization will be behind feature flag `authz.canonicalize_tokens_v2`. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 72h then ramp. Need a canary checklist - can someone add to the task?

sophia.li: I'll add a checklist to TASK-4873: pre-canary smoke, telemetry probes (latency, 4xx/5xx trends), sample logs retention for 30d.

sec-analyst: Uploaded CSV: https://internal.redwood/secure/artifacts/authz-missing-events-2026-04.csv. Summary: primary gaps in delegated token flow between service-proxy and auth-service (rows flagged: 23, 41, 52).

noah.kim: I'll use that CSV as the ground truth for the replay and add a small matcher that fails CI if new code causes regressions. Also proposing we set an SLO: 99.9% audit-event emission for critical auth paths over 30d. Thoughts?

sophia.li: SLO sounds reasonable. Set provisional SLO and we'll review at the weekly postmortem rollup. @ops-bot can you create a dashboard tile for audit completeness?

ops-bot: Dashboard tile created -> DashID: audit-completeness-2026.

owen.martin: Regarding recurring patterns: I noticed three incidents in the last 9 months where token parsing differences (whitespace, padding) caused silent acceptance. I added a heatmap row to the postmortem rollup sheet: https://redwood.atlassian.net/spreadsheets/authz-rollup-2026 (see sheet 'heatmap').

noah.kim: Good catch. I'll add an automated nightly validator that scans stored tokens for non-canonical forms and alerts if >0.1% of tokens are non-canonical. That should catch regressions early.

sophia.li: Can we also add runbook versioning? Past friction was runbook edits not linked to PRs. New rule: runbook updates must be in the same PR as the fix or have `docs-sync` label.

sec-analyst: Noted. Will update runbook template to include a short risk checklist and rollback steps for token changes.

owen.martin: Blocker: need a representative old-format token for unit tests. @sec-analyst can you add masked test vectors to TASK-4873?

sec-analyst: Done. Uploaded masked vectors to secure path and added link in TASK-4873.

noah.kim: Scheduling first check-in: 2026-04-28 10:00 for quick status and smoke results. I'll create invite and add agenda: audit replay output + canary plan + metrics.

sophia.li: I've added labels `authz-remed`, `postmortem-rollup`, `recurring-pattern` to all tasks. Also adding a quarterly review to ensure these clusters are tracked over time. Owner for quarterly rollup: @sophia.li.

owen.martin: One ops note: will include a temporary correlation header `X-Authz-Canary` for requests flagged by the feature flag to help triage.

noah.kim: If canary shows unexpected 4xx, we should auto-disable the flag and open an incident-free triage. Can we automate that?

sophia.li: Yes, let's add a simple circuit-breaker: if canary 4xx rate > 0.5% over 5min, flip flag off. @ops-bot can you add a rule?

ops-bot: Automation rule created -> canary-circuit-breaker-2026.

sec-analyst: Final ask: when PRs land, please set `postmortem-remediation: AUTHZ-2026` in the PR body and add links back to original incident. This helps quarterly aggregation.

sophia.li: Agreed. I'll follow up next week with the rollup summary and tag action item statuses. Thanks all. :spiral_calendar_pad:

noah.kim: Ack.

owen.martin: Ack.

ops-bot: Scheduled recurring sync -> Fridays at 09:00 (channel: #incidents, thread: 1807709999).
